Jo (Growth): Quick check-in 10m. Launch posts + webinar funnel need: final KW mapping, JSON-LD for the landing, internal linking plan, and a redirect policy. Can we split? :zap:
Ethan-SEO: I'll own KW mapping + meta title/H1 variants. Focusing on commercial intent + 'how to' queries.
Marta-Content: I'll write the benchmark blurb and webinar hook. Keep it short: measurable + technical hook.
Priya-Dev: I'll do the redirect rules and ensure utm preservation. Recommend 302 for 48h then flip to 301 if stable.
seo-bot: Crawl snapshot: 3 pages flagged noindex, 1 legacy promo with redirect chain. Full: https://internal.crawl/1734567890
Ethan-SEO: Draft KW set: "LLM inference latency", "predictable inference cost", "inference batching", "dedicated inference GPU", "inference caching best practices". Map to landing H1/H2.
Marta-Content: Hook: "Live benchmark + demo: reduce p50 latency and inference spend without sacrificing accuracy." One-line invite for email.
Priya-Dev: Redirect snippet (nginx) preserving utm:
```
rewrite ^/promo/old-launch$ /webinar/inference-playbook?utm_source=promo&$args redirect;
# after QA convert to 301
return 301 $scheme://$host/webinar/inference-playbook?$query_string;
```
Jo (Growth): Internal links: add from 'inference economics' pillar -> landing using anchor "predictable inference cost" and from 'runtime optimizations' -> docs on caching. Limit to 2-3 anchor variations.
Ethan-SEO: On schema I'll draft Event + Speaker Person + FAQ JSON-LD. Use OnlineEventAttendanceMode and include startDate in ISO.
Jo (Growth): Owners: Ethan = KW + schema; Priya = redirects; Marta = invite copy; I'll assemble checklist and schedule a 9am PT follow-up. Thanks! :rocket:
